explanation.title: How does it work?
explanation.description1: Easily bridge your crypto assets between networks, without ever leaving your wallet.
explanation.description2: Blockchains are independent of each other, and can’t interact with each other - That's where bridges come in. It’s similar in principle to exchanging money while traveling to different countries, a bridge allows you to transfer assets across various blockchains.
explanation.description3: Directly and immediately bridging tokens in NEON is convenient and allows you to save time and pay lower fees.
explanation.alert: COZ are not maintainers of this bridging process - Neo Global Development is the maintainer.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.description: Buy and sell tokens without relying on an exchange! Neon provides an effortless and secure way to buy and sell digital assets using fiat money.
howItWorks.observation: After the transfer has been completed, your new tokens will take a few moments to arrive.

processBuyTokens.text: <1>This process uses an embedded widget.</1> When buying tokens, some personal data might be requested for KYC purposes. <2>Larger sales require a greater amount of KYC data.</2>
processBuyTokens.kyc: <1>Once the KYC process is complete:</1> You will need to provide a destination address for your tokens. From the 'Wallets & Accounts' panel, copy the destination address of your desired Neon account.
processBuyTokens.alert: Ensure that the account you select is compatible with the network of your purchased token!

processSellTokens.text: <1>This process uses an embedded widget.</1> When selling tokens, some personal data might be requested for KYC purposes. <2>Larger sales require a greater amount of KYC data.</2>
processSellTokens.kyc: <1>Once the KYC process is complete:</1> You will need to send your tokens to the deposit address using the ‘Make a Deposit’ button.  Please ensure that you transfer the correct amount of tokens to the deposit address! You can also copy a destination address of your desired Neon account, from the 'Wallets & Accounts' panel.
processSellTokens.alert: Deposit transactions need to be sent from the <1>same address</1> used in the widget!
